goal.criterion: Complete durable reviewed release to actual host consumption with qualified CI, fencing, restart reconciliation and verified rollback
goal.rationale: Replace the demonstrated one-shot continuation with a reusable owner-controlled delivery component; retain existing Releases and ReleaseQueue authority.

plan.objective: Implement the complete Durable delivery controller: consolidated Batch 3 implementation section of bound SPEC. Read existing release authority, queue fencing, GitWorkspace, deployment and process ownership end to end first; reuse them. Deliver real adapters and CLI, not only abstract ports. Preserve all review/policy/ticket gates, exact CI/head and consumed host identity. Keep production opt-in; no live GitHub writes, task changes or models during worker execution. Use actual disposable child processes/files for local boundaries and label injected faults. Run ONLY the two exact commands in that section; no full suite. Legacy tests claims contain exact successful commands only; failures/native unavailable checks in summary. Independent Codex reviews the fixed whole path/matrix once, separating critical reachable findings from recommendations. No merge/deploy by worker.
acceptance_criteria: Existing Releases approval and ReleaseQueue fencing authorize the exact plan; no accepted-row shortcut or new approval authority.
Bounded durable tick continues publish/CI/merge/drain/switch/consumption across restart and response loss without duplicate effects or nested transactions.
Concrete host adapters, canary/verified rollback and read-only monitoring/structured logs meet the fixed acceptance matrix; actual live qualification remains owner work.
Scoped tests and Ruff pass; preserve all failed and unexecuted evidence honestly.
